title: Employees and Departments
statement: The `employees` table has columns id, name, dept_id. The `departments` table has columns id, name. Write a query that returns `employee_name, department_name` for every employee, joining employees to departments on dept_id = departments.id, ordered by employee id.
starter_code:
SELECT e.name, d.name
FROM employees e
INNER JOIN departments d ON -- TODO
ORDER BY e.id;
hints: Use INNER JOIN on e.dept_id = d.id
